brief: An autumn bonfire on the allotments. The block runs a full year (harvest, fallow, dig weather, cabbages) and autumn is its emptiest season on screen: leaves fall, litter lies, nothing burns. On dry, calm autumn afternoons (leafFallF() > 0.3, !raining, wetF() < 0.4, windF() < 0.5, roughly 1 day in 3 by hash(day, k) — histogram the predicate before choosing k) a holder lights a heap on ONE fixed bare cell of the block, chosen off the grid clear of the timber fence, the shed, the POND and every plot lattice cell (read fallowPlots()' lattice; do not re-derive it). fireF 0..1 rate-capped: kindles over ~1 h sim, burns 3–4 h, dies to embers. A smoke column in drawSmoke()'s own idiom leaning windDir()·windF(); a holder (spawnAllotAgent()'s a.dig shape: sendToPlot to the fire cell, 'stand' with a fork, a.tend) who feeds it and leaves when it dies; litter[] within 3 cells consumed as it burns; an ember glow after dark in a screen pass AFTER applyLight (the night-colour law), visible from the wide shot. Named: 'the bonfire, smoking' / 'the bonfire, down to embers' / 'an allotment holder, feeding the bonfire'; one announce line at kindling. Snow or rain arriving puts it out (fireF target 0).
successLooksLike: probes/bonfire-year.mjs, 8 seeds × 26 days: fires on 25–40% of autumn days, 0 in summer, 0 in rain or wind > 0.5; a holder stands at it on every fire; litter within 3 cells falls to 0 while it burns; the glow is visible at 21:00 in a shots/b91-bonfire-night.png crop and the smoke leans the same way as the chimneys in the same frame; census PASS (reshuffle only); filmstrip 0 POP at kindling. ~80–140 lines.
avoid: Not a new tile and not a structure — one cell, one item, drawn live; do not move the census baseline. Do not put it on a plot (the lattice is harvest territory) or against the fence. No R() in the draw; the day's fire is a hash. Do not let the holder's 'stand' block ALLEY_Y.
